previous_issues.note: 'Mine' is now the CRM salesperson or scheduler/DMS advisor, never the round-robin pick or a takeover claimant, with a team view until the source is connected (v2 Recommendation). The exception I asked for (Spyne assignee where round-robin is the store's record) was not taken, and the fixed intent rules it out. I accept that.
'Action items join the owner at read time, never reassigned' and 'this read-only release' mean nothing is written to the VinSolutions task or lead owner.

For SMS, chat and calls, the entry rule now means a customer is waiting on a person, and 'What Vini fully answers stays out.' Email still uses the old rule (new issue r2-4). The queue is still not sized per rep per day (carried as a request).

Cleared by a console reply or call, CRM activity where read, or a one-click clear logged with actor and time. Viewing never clears it. The CRM activity read is in the risk table as unknown [Q18]. The one-click clear opens a gaming hole (new issue r2-2).
The TL;DR now says it removes the Action Items cross-check and that 'the CRM still closes the record'.
'Manager view: count and oldest wait per owner' is in the Recommendation. It only works where an owner is connected, and the asking rooftop is not connected (new issue r2-1).
Escalation after N minutes in store hours now texts the named role. The owner alert channel is still unnamed (new minor r2-6). Escalation 'moves' the item off the rep (new issue r2-3).

A baseline from reply events ships before the UI, a target is set per department, and appointments shown are tracked as a check. Shows meet my outcome lens. No target number is acceptable until the baseline exists.

The CRM-first full-value path is stated: tasks on the CRM salesperson and console replies posted back. It needs certified write-back per provider and is planned after this read-only release. The date is open question 6 (PM).
